line: Crowley's account of Atu XIII: the letter Nun, Scorpio ruled by Mars, and the figure of the dance of death.

sections.title: What Crowley says the card is
sections.line: The letter and the sign, with the ruler he names for the sign.

quotes.quote: This card is attributed to the letter Nun, which means a fish;
It refers to the Zodiacal sign of Scorpio, which is ruled by Mars,

sections.title: Its path on the Tree
sections.line: Crowley says this path leads from Tiphareth, with the far end not named. The table gives Key Scale path 24, with no sephira pair in the text.

quotes.quote: On the Tree of Life, Atu XIII and XV are symmetrically placed; they lead from Tiphareth, the human consciousness, to the spheres in which Thought (on the one hand) and Bliss (on the other) are developed.
These paths are the paths which join the ten numbers on the

sections.title: What the card figures, in his words
sections.line: Crowley's description of the figure and the water imagery of the card.

quotes.quote: The card itself represents the dance of death; the figure is a skeleton bearing a scythe,
the symbol of life beneath the waters; life travelling through the waters.
